title: Ceres Nanoparticles Concentration and Extraction using MagMAX Wastewater kit
author: Shannon Fitz
materials: Sample is now ready for Part 2.

steps.title: Mix sample and pre‑incubate
steps.instruction: Invert the 35 mL environmental water sample 5 times, then let it sit for 45 seconds at room temperature.

steps.title: Filter and transfer sample
steps.instruction: Agitate the sample, filter it through a coffee filter to remove suspended solids, and transfer 35 mL of the filtered water into a clean 50 mL conical tube.

steps.title: Add Nanotrap Enhancement
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Nanotrap Enhancement Reagent 3 (ER3) to the tube, cap, and invert 2 times to mix.

steps.title: Add Nanotrap particles
steps.instruction: Add 525 µL Nanotrap Microbiome A Particles to the tube, cap, and invert 2 times to mix the particles.

steps.title: Incubate with particles
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 30 minutes, inverting every 5 minutes or using a rotator.

steps.title: Magnetic separation (first)
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a DynaMag‑50 magnetic rack for 10 minutes to separate the Nanotrap particles from the liquid.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Using a serological pipette (or a P‑1000/P‑200 if needed), carefully discard the supernatant without disturbing the Nanotrap pellet; optionally use a smaller pipette to remove any remaining liquid.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in Buffer 2
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL Nanotrap Buffer 2, then pipette against the tube walls until the pellet is completely resuspended.

steps.title: Transfer suspension
steps.instruction: Transfer the Nanotrap particle suspension to a new 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Magnetic separation (second)
steps.instruction: Place the 2 mL tube on a DynaMag‑2 magnetic rack for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Discard second supernatant
steps.instruction: Using a P‑1000 pipette (and a smaller pipette if any liquid remains), discard the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Add Lysis Solution
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL MagMAX‱ Microbiome Lysis Solution and pipette up‑and‑down until the Nanotrap particles are fully resuspended.

steps.title: Heat‑lysis incubation
steps.instruction: Close the tube lid and incubate on a heating block at 56 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Separate particles post‑lysis
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a DynaMag‑2 magnetic rack for 2 minutes; if droplets cling to the lid, briefly centrifuge at 2000 g for 2–5 seconds before magnetic separation.

steps.title: Collect lysate
steps.instruction: Transfer 400 µL of the supernatant/lysate to a new 2 mL collection tube and discard the Nanotrap pellet.

steps.title: Add Binding Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 530 µL MagMAX Binding Buffer to the lysate.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL MagMAX Proteinase K to the mixture.

steps.title: Add Magnetic Beads
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL MagMAX Magnetic Beads to the mixture.

steps.title: Mix and heat
steps.instruction: Vortex to mix, then incubate on a heat block at 65 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Separate beads (first wash)
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a DynaMag‑2 magnetic rack for 2 minutes, then discard the supernatant; if liquid remains on the lid, briefly centrifuge at 2000 g for 2–5 seconds before separation.

steps.title: Wash with buffer
steps.instruction: Add 1000 µL MagMAX Wash Buffer, resuspend the magnetic beads by pipetting.

steps.title: Separate beads (second wash)
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a DynaMag‑2 magnetic rack for 2 minutes and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Ethanol wash 1
steps.instruction: Add 1000 µL 80 % ethanol, resuspend the beads, then place on a DynaMag‑2 rack for 2 minutes and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Ethanol wash 2
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL 80 % ethanol, resuspend the beads, then place on a DynaMag‑2 rack for 2 minutes and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Centrifuge to remove residual ethanol
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube in a mini‑centrifuge at 2000 g for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Remove excess ethanol
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a DynaMag‑2 rack and use a smaller pipette to remove any remaining 80 % ethanol.

steps.title: Elution
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL MagMAX Elution Solution, resuspend the beads, close the caps, and incubate on a heat block at 65 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Separate beads (final)
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a DynaMag‑2 magnetic rack for 2 minutes; if droplets are present on the lid, briefly centrifuge at 2000 g for 2–5 seconds before separation.

steps.title: Collect purified nucleic acid
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a new tube; the sample is ready for downstream analysis or can be stored at –80 °C (avoid multiple freeze‑thaw cycles).
